label: At GO after a rewarded common a1->S1 trial, strongest early in the episode.
short_terms: (phase == GO) * last_is("a1 S1 r") * np.maximum(40 - ep_trial, 0)
terms: (phase == GO) * last_is("a1 S1 r") * np.maximum(40 - ep_trial, 0) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_state == -1) * (prev_reward == 1) * (belief_lo > 0) * np.maximum(40 - ep_trial, 0) ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a1 S1 r") ;; (phase == GO) * belief_lo * (prev_reward == 1) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_action == 2) ;; (phase == GO) * (tv("action", -2) == 1) * (tv("reward", -2) == 1) * np.maximum(40 - ep_trial, 0)
explanation: GO-only feature (zero at D1/D2). Magnitude about 0.3 at GO when the previous trial was a1 -> S1 rewarded, decaying linearly to zero by about trial 40 of the episode; near zero after any other previous-trial pattern, including a2 S1 r. Short term test R2 beyond timing 0.44 vs free fit 0.55 (79%, just under the explained bar). Free fit adds window-first-trial GO steps where the previous trial is unknown but was rewarded and belief favours S1 (these also fire), plus small belief and a2-penalty terms. The future variable (this choice = a1 x prev rewarded x early) scores higher (0.55 dev) because the feature tracks the upcoming a1 choice, but it is not recorded; the observed-only last_is version is recorded.
